lines.en: I march about the yard in short steps.
My boots tap on the ground.
Black clay; my steps are light.
I patrol along the yard wall.
I stop and listen to the ranks.
I march toward the far end of the line.
Step by step, never out of order.
My little banner rides my shoulder.
I crunch across fallen leaves.
I turn, crisply.
I make my third round of the yard.
Wherever there is noise, I walk.
I stand at attention without a quiver.
My clay isn't fully dry yet.

lines.zh: 我握着小木棍，握得很紧
lines.en: I grip my little stick tightly.
I'm waiting for my master's order.
My shadow lies at my feet.
I tilt my head, then straighten.

lines.zh: 黑色的我看着不太好惹
lines.en: Black as I am, I look unfriendly.
I flex one finger.

lines.zh: 地上有我掉的一点粘土
lines.en: A bit of my clay fell on the ground.
I pick it up and press it back on.
I'm deciding if you're an enemy.
You stand much taller than I.
But you're only one.
I take one small step forward.
I raise my stick, straight.

lines.zh: 黑陶土的脸，看不清表情。
lines.en: A black clay face shows no expression.
But I won't fall back.
I say nothing; do not ask.
I watch your hands.
Come closer and I'll answer it.
I bring my stick across to block.
My eyes are two black dots.
A chip of my clay comes off.

lines.zh: 我是用黑染料染的黏土。
lines.en: I'm clay dyed black.
A crack runs down from my shoulder.
I straighten my body.
The clay's chipped, but usable.
My stick arm is bent a little.
I set my stance again.
This damage doesn't break formation.
I'm still in position.
The order hasn't been withdrawn.
Clay doesn't eat.
You hold that up. I don't understand.
I neither eat nor drink; I need a battlefield.

lines.zh: 东西放下，别举到我面前。
lines.en: Put it down; do not hold it before me.
My attention is elsewhere.
That won't upgrade me.
What I want is leather and stick.
I can't take this.
Keep it.
Until the order's done, I don't eat.
The bump shifted me a step.
I bring the step back at once.
You've stepped into my position.
I look up, my black face blank.
I drop back half a step and re-form.
Some of my clay stuck to your boot.
I won't strike over this.
But don't come further.
My stick is still raised.
That step, I yielded.
Soldiers don't speak of that.
I need only the same company.
You have your banner, I have mine.
In the ranks, there's no mine or yours.
The ranks move, so I move.
I'll guard your flank.
No order comes. We stand.
Until the clay cracks.
All I have is this black clay body.
Don't leave the formation.
I pick up a short stick.
This one is like mine.
I tuck the banner at my waist.
I can't hold anything too heavy.
This clay could patch me.

lines.zh: 黑泥补上我胸口的缺口。
lines.en: Black clay fills the gap in my chest.
I pick up what I can use.
You dropped it? Then I take it.
This isn't spoils.
I carry it and walk on.
I've marked the target.
First I raise the banner.
I count. Only one.
That will do.
I begin to advance.
Step by step, without running.
I tighten my grip on the stick.
My clay hardens a little.
It's ten paces off.
I quicken as I go.
Five now.
I raise my weapon.
I'm all set.
Retreat means nothing.
I walk straight at it.
It goes left; I turn left.
My steps are small but sure.
First I put it under pressure.
It retreats; I keep advancing.
I raise the stick to strike.
Only three paces left.
It raised its hand.
I don't care. I keep straight.

lines.zh: 黏土做的身体不怕这些
lines.en: A clay body doesn't fear this.
It runs, and I speed up.
I'm behind it.
I'm right behind it now.
It can't turn in time.
I bring it down.
I strike with the stick.
That caught a shin.
I add another blow to its shoulder.
It falls back; I step in.
I leap and hit its knee.
This small frame is hard to hit.
It kicks me away.
I roll once on the ground.
I get up and charge again.
My clay chips, but holds.
I still hold the stick.
That one truly landed.
I stand and catch my breath.
The ranks are still behind me.
I can still fight.
The black stick falls again.

lines.zh: 我被放在地上，站了起来
lines.en: I'm set down, and I stand up.
My clay is still wet.
First I look at my hands.
Black dye soaked all through me.
I lift a foot, leaving a print.
There are other soldiers in the yard.
I march over to them.
Someone hands me a stick.
I grip it. It fits.
I take my place.
Stand. Await orders.
I raise my head out of the earth.
The fire hardens and cracks me.
I fall and break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我的黏土就软了
lines.en: Soaked, my clay goes soft.

lines.zh: 炸飞的黑陶土，散了又聚。
lines.en: Blasted black clay scatters and gathers again.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎穿了我的胸
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my chest.

lines.zh: 这股力量捏着我的黏土
lines.en: This force squeezes my clay.
I don't eat, but I do dry out.
Lightning fires me hard for an instant.
I break into dust and fall.
